content:
We need to combine subnetworks into full topology. Likely just merge resistor IDs ensuring unique IDs. Subnet1 has R1-R4, subnet2 has R1-R3, subnet3 has R1-R3. Need total 10 resistors per notes. So rename to avoid duplicates: maybe R1-R4 from subnet1, R5-R7 from subnet2, R8-R10 from subnet3. Combine connections, updating resistor IDs.

We can construct final JSON.

Check measurements maybe not needed. Just combine.

Let's produce:

resistors: {"R1":5.0,"R2":10.0,"R3":15.0,"R4":20.0,"R5":15.0,"R6":10.0,"R7":20.0,"R8":20.0,"R9":15.0,"R10":10.0}

Connections: from subnet1 unchanged. Subnet2 connections replace R1,R2,R3 with R5,R6,R7. Subnet3 replace with R8,R9,R10.

List connections:

Subnet1:
["A","N_a1","R1"],["N_a1","N_a2","R2"],["N_a2","N_a3","R3"],["N_a3","X1","R4"]

Subnet2:
["N_b1","N_b2","R5"],["N_b1","X1","R6"],["N_b2","X2","R7"]

Subnet3:
["B","Nc2","R8"],["Nc2","Nc1","R9"],["Nc1","X2","R10"]

Return JSON string.
